courses.title: I AM the Unstoppable Dream
courses.description: A self-paced online programme built on her book 30 Days to Unstoppable, moving through seven steps tied to seven laws of the universe with guided meditations, sacred-geometry drawing and a large mandala painting. It includes monthly studio Zoom calls and a community of participants.

flags: Its page calls it a course to 'ease anxiety about the state of our world': wellbeing wording only, not repeated in the description. With it the listing has 9 offerings in its plan.
